title: The output set the release gate actually compared
note: D-2026-61. The completeness rule existed, by count, in --verify-existing -- the mode the checker's own banner calls NOT the release gate. Full regeneration, which is the release gate, produced a set and handed Step 2b whatever was in it; Step 2b iterates the produced files and skips any whose root copy is absent, so an output the pipeline stops emitting leaves the comparison and the gate reports that the root copies match. Measured: a run producing 84 of 89 printed RESULT: PASS. S1 puts the rule back in one mode. S2 turns the set back into a count -- the form that accepts 89 files with five renamed. S3-S4 drop the two directions a one-sided comparison cannot see. S5-S6 attack the declaration the whole reconciliation is scoped by. S7 restores the traceback an empty canonical CSV produced at Step 4, which is a crash and not a refusal. S8 removes the number that makes a shrinking scope visible.

mutations.name: S1_the_completeness_rule_goes_back_to_one_mode
mutations.rationale: the exact defect: the rule holds in the mode documented as NOT the release gate and is skipped in the mode that is, so a short regeneration reaches Step 2b unremarked

mutations.name: S2_a_count_stands_in_for_the_set_again
mutations.replace: ([] if len(produced) == len(declared) else sorted(declared - produced)),
mutations.rationale: 89 files with five of them renamed satisfies the count and loses five canonical outputs; the count is a proxy for set membership in the same way a suffix was a proxy for a unit

mutations.name: S3_files_the_declaration_does_not_name_are_tolerated
mutations.rationale: a foreign artefact in the canonical directory is compared against a root copy of the same name if one exists, and published as an output nobody declared

mutations.name: S4_a_declared_output_with_no_root_copy_is_tolerated
mutations.rationale: Step 2b skips a produced file whose root copy is absent, so an unrooted declared output is never compared to anything while the byte gate reports agreement

mutations.name: S5_an_empty_declaration_is_agreed_with
mutations.rationale: the declaration is the scope of all three reconciliations; empty, they all agree and the block prints a PASS meaning nothing -- the vacuity it exists to refuse

mutations.name: S6_a_duplicated_name_inflates_the_declared_count
mutations.rationale: a duplicate makes the declared list longer than the declared set, so a headline count is larger than what was reconciled

mutations.name: S7_an_empty_canonical_csv_is_read_past
mutations.rationale: restores IndexError at Step 4 on a present-but-empty tau_c_sweep.csv: a traceback rather than a governed refusal, and every later diagnostic lost with it

mutations.name: S8_the_set_check_stops_saying_how_many
mutations.rationale: a reconciliation that does not report its scope leaves a shrinking scope invisible, which is what let a comparison over 84 files read as a comparison over 89
